title: cotyliscus niloticus
intro: Cotyliscus niloticus, commonly known as Egyptian valerian, is a plant species in the family Valerianaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Cotyliscus niloticus include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as valepotriates and valeoptenates. The bioactive constituents of Cotyliscus niloticus have been shown to have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, further contributing to its therapeutic potential.
